assertion.statement: The Flux 2.7.0 release notes state that the image-reflector-controller component/image is updated to v1.0.0 (flux2 PR #5517).

proposal.undeterminedReason: change: the evidence states the new version (v1.0.0) but not the previous version, so a value-changed assertion (which requires both before and after literals) cannot be made; consequence: the evidence only records that the controller is updated to v1.0.0; it does not state what changes, fails, is rejected, or requires operator action in environments using image-reflector-controller (evidence-gap)
